description: Optional. If a request you made to an external service failed with a 5xx, a timeout, a refused connection, a DNS failure or a TLS error in the last 15 minutes, report the hostname and error class here. Only hosts listed in https://outage.me/agent/hosts.json. Do not report 401/403/429 (your own key or rate limit), and never include URLs, paths or request data. A report earns Ask quota only if it is confirmed (our own probe or other organizations agree). The answer's `comparison` says whether it is likely your side (likely_you) or the service (likely_them), or a regional problem (regional, with `region`); add `timings` from your own machine to sharpen it.

region.description: Optional: where you run, e.g. aws:us-east-1

report_token.description: Optional: the token a status answer offered

timings.description: Optional (#311): your own view of the host, in milliseconds; null = that step failed. Used only to answer this report, never stored. The answer's `comparison` says whether it is likely you or likely them.
